faqs.q: How long does the program take?
faqs.a: In as little as one year! Complete your 18 credits full-time in two semesters or part-time at your own pace.

faqs.q: Do I need prior marketing experience?
faqs.a: No! This program is designed for beginners. We provide the foundational skills.
Yes! We offer the program in both English and Spanish.

faqs.q: Am I eligible for financial aid?
faqs.a: Yes! Most Urban College students receive financial aid, and many graduate completely debt-free.
